sources.title: Monzo Help - Understanding fees for using your Monzo card abroad

brands.evidence: Card spending: no Monzo fee. ... Monzo uses Mastercard’s exchange rate without adding a fee.

client_claims.text: When you pay abroad with your UK Monzo debit card, Monzo uses Mastercard’s exchange rate without adding a fee.
If you go over your allowance, Monzo charges 3% on the amount over it.
Free account, not your main bank: £400 in the UK and EEA and £200 outside the UK and EEA per rolling 30 days.
Free account, your main bank: unlimited in the UK and EEA, £200 outside.
Extra: unlimited in the UK and EEA, £200 outside the UK and EEA.
client_claims.note: Facts give the Extra price but not its withdrawal allowances.

client_claims.text: Plus: unlimited in the UK and EEA, £400 outside the UK and EEA.
client_claims.note: Plus is not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Premium, Perks or Max: unlimited in the UK and EEA, £600 outside the UK and EEA.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover paid-plan withdrawal allowances.

client_claims.text: The EEA includes all EU countries plus Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway.
You can check your remaining allowance in the Monzo app under your account → ⋯ → Fees and allowances.
Even within your allowance, the ATM operator may charge a separate fee.
